summary: Verified the mystical-aura replacement: rotating conic-gradient + border ring have been removed and replaced with a SINGLE pulsing accent-colored blurred glow behind the reveal panel. Tested via guided flow (interest → location → chips → seal) on default (dark) and fantasy themes. DOM inspection and animation sampling confirm the spec is met on both themes with no console errors.
action_items: Dead code cleanup: `auraBg` constant at /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx line 71 is no longer referenced anywhere (previously used by the old rotating conic-gradient aura). Safe to remove.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is ~1782 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; should be split into smaller components (RevealStage already extracted, but filters/guided integration/aura/etc. all still coexist).
Line 71 `auraBg` is dead code after the aura rewrite (only remaining use of the conic-gradient string). Remove to avoid stale styling drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guided flow to trigger mystical-aura: (1) click [data-testid='guided-interest-food'], (2) fill [data-testid='guided-zip-input'] with '10001', (3) WAIT ~1.5s for zip validation, (4) click [data-testid='guided-location-next'] WITHOUT force (force=True prevented advancement), (5) click [data-testid='guided-surprise-me'], (6) click [data-testid='guided-seal-button']. Aura is present from seal until 3s after result lands; capture within that window. To switch themes, set localStorage.ff_theme (e.g., 'fantasy') and reload; also set ff_build='2026.06-288' and sessionStorage.ff_build_reloaded='1' to bypass build gate. Remove ff_guided_done to force guided flow to appear.

detailed_findings.layering: Aura wrapper is position:absolute -inset-4 (default z-index 0), reveal panel is sibling with class 'relative z-10' — panel content sits above aura, glow halos edges only ✅
detailed_findings.regression: End-to-end reveal flow works on both themes: shuffle runs, result card lands with restaurant details (Altair Restaurant NYC on default, queensyard on fantasy), no console errors observed
